step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram represents AlertLogic's telemetry data ingestion and highly scalable MapReduce search system built on AWS. The ingestion path consists of Ingestion Kinesis receiving raw telemetry from customer agents, passing it to Ingestion ECS for pre-processing, and persisting it to a 25 PB S3 Data Lake. The search processing workflow starts at Search ECS which receives search queries and passes execution planning to a Scheduler Lambda. The Scheduler Lambda enqueues tasks into SQS and directly triggers worker Filter Lambdas, while SQS triggers Step Functions to manage execution state and coordinate the Filter Lambdas. The worker Filter Lambdas scale up to tens of thousands of instances using Erlang runtime to filter and enrich search results. Intermediate results are written to an S3 bucket and streamed via Search Kinesis to an Aggregator Lambda for final aggregation.
